referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This data set includes the material use for the manufacturing of an average bicycle with an additional electric motor. Manufacturing of the bike parts is assumed to take place in China. Transport to Europe included.

geography.text: Data cover manufacturing in China and retail in Europe

technology.text: Electric bicycle with electric motor at wheel-hub and LiNCM battery pack, 100Wh/kg-

representativeness.extrapolations: Electric motor and battery extrapolated from BEV, Manufacturing plant is extrapolated from passenger car plant, electricity consumption extrapolated according to weight ratio from passenger car
